calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CAST(f.vat_rate * 100 AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS vat_rate_pct,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CAST(f.vat_rate * 100 AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS vat_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate
